messages:
anita: Quick async check — I'm assembling the model-landing playbook matrix for the catalog launch. Two models in scope: orca-lite-6b and tungsten-v1. Need short status on: licensing, perf profile, quantization plan, and canary infra. Please reply with owner + one-line status.

matt: I can take perf for orca-lite-6b. Benchjobs running now, should have baseline numbers by EOD tomorrow. Noted some memory jitter at seq_len=1024 on p4d.

lea: Legal quick note — orca-lite-6b is under MIT-compatible terms per upstream, we just need the SPDX header in the weights bundle. tungsten-v1 has a CLA in-flight (upstream author asked to re-sign); asking legal ops to nudge. ETA by Tue.

raj: Canary infra owner here. I can host two canary pools (eu-west + us-west) for both models. Need the Docker image tags and target qps. Can we limit canary to 50qps per model to start?

anita: @raj yep 50qps first pass. @matt add the bench numbers into the matrix so we can map to pool sizes. @lea thanks — please drop the final license note in the sheet.

matt: perf command I'm running for reproducibility:
```
./infra/bench/run_bench --model orca-lite-6b --seq 512 --batch 8 --iters 100 --out /tmp/bench_orca.json
```
Will paste a short summary when done.

oliver: Docs/devex note — SDK examples and model metadata schema need a small tweak for tungsten-v1 because it returns structured tool-calls in some prompts. I'll prepare a PR but need the final model output schema. @matt can you share a sample output?

matt: sample -> pasted below (trimmed):
```
{"id":"resp-123","choices":[{"text":"call_tool:update_record","tool_args":{"id":42,"val":"ok"}}]}
```
Mostly standard but we should include tool-calling in the metadata flag.

lea: Legal: added comment to the sheet and flagged tungsten-v1 as "pending CLA". If CLA doesn't arrive by Tue COB, recommend we hold tungsten-v1 from the public catalog until cleared.

anita: Good call. For launch gating: must have (1) license cleared, (2) perf profile attached, (3) quantization notes, (4) canary plan. Any open blockers besides tungsten CLA and the mem jitter?

matt: mem jitter is under investigation; might be a kernel scheduling artifact on the test infra. Trying with pinned NUMA and different CUDA driver. If that doesn't reproduce on p3, we can still proceed with canary but with narrower traffic.

raj: If jitter persists, I'll provision a smaller dedicated pool (gpu-small) for canary so it doesn't impact shared capacity.

oliver: I'll open the SDK PR and tag reviewers. ETA PR tomorrow morning.

anita: Action summary: (1) @matt finish perf + attach profile to matrix (EOD tomorrow). (2) @lea confirm CLA status (Tue). (3) @raj reserve canary pools 50qps and gpu-small fallback. (4) @oliver PR for SDK + metadata flag. I'll update the playbook matrix with these items. Ping here when done (or just add comments in the sheet). :thumbsup:

cora-bot: Ticket created: INF-3421 "orca-lite-6b playbook matrix entry" assigned to matt, due 2026-03-24.

matt: noted INF-3421. I'll link bench output and the perf summary in the ticket when ready.

lea: I'll update the sheet and drop the legal verdict thread there — will ping if anything changes.

anita: Thanks all — day-two launch checklist will be the follow-up thread after perf numbers land.
